newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES WEAKER ON MOST UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES WEAKER ON MOST UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted weaker against most hard currencies at the close of Thursday interbank trade, dealers said.

"It appears the market is quite short. The Reserve Bank sold a little bit of money into the market but I think it was too little too late. The dollar was just falling the whole day," commented one dealer.
"We need the central bank to come in with a really big chunk to install confidence," he added.

The Zimbabwe dollar, which hit a low of 11.1075/1175 during the day, closed at 11.1025/1125 against the key U.S. dollar after the Reserve Bank intervention. This compared with 11.0725/0825 at the end of Wednesday's session.

Against the mark it also weakened to 6.5955/6050 from 6.5400/5500, reflecting the German currency's gains over the U.S. dollar overseas and was at 2.4770/4810 against the rand, slightly down from 2.4735/4775. It however finished little changed against sterling at 17.8775/9055 from 17.8770/9035.
